payload.instruction: Change the image into pencil drawing

decision.question: To what extent has the image been transformed from the source into a pencil drawing?
decision.criteria: Pass only when the scene as a whole convincingly reads as a pencil drawing: photographic rendering is replaced by visibly drawn, pencil-like linework and/or tonal shading across the main scene. Fail only when there is no observable drawing-like change toward that style compared with the source. Partial when there is genuine but weak or incomplete drawing-like treatment, such as visible sketch-like texture, linework, or tonal rendering, but substantial photographic structure or texture remains. Muted color, desaturation, grain, reduced detail, or softened contours alone do not establish drawing-like progress or a convincing pencil drawing; judge whether the combined evidence visibly renders the scene as drawn rather than merely washed out, blurred, or recolored. Unknown only when visual evidence is insufficient to judge.
decision.binding: Compare the same regions in the source and edited images, including the food, glassware, and table setting. Inspect whether photographic forms have been replaced by visibly pencil-drawn linework or tonal shading, rather than relying on muted color, reduced detail, grain, or soft contours alone. Pass requires convincing drawn rendering across the scene as a whole. Partial requires observable drawing-like treatment but allows substantial photographic structure or texture to remain. Fail means no observable drawing-like change toward the requested style. Reserve unknown for genuinely insufficient visual evidence; do not infer a pass from a broadly positive description without supporting drawn visual features.
